blocks.text: Lipids non-polar molecules ka ek dheela-dhala bayan-shuda group hain jo pani mein hal nahin hote magar ether aur alcohol jaise organic solvents mein hal hote hain. Yeh mutanawwe (diverse) group hain aur acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids aur prostaglandins ke taur par darja-band (classified) kiye jate hain.
Acylglycerols (fats aur oils)

Acylglycerols do subunits, glycerol aur fatty acids, se bane hain. Jo acylglycerols kamre ke darja-hararat (temperature) par maaye (liquid) hon woh oils hain; jo thos (solid) hon woh fats hain. Janwaron mein zyada tar acylglycerols fats hain; podon mein zyada tar oils, maslan moongphali ka tel, makai ka tel aur arandi (castor) ka tel. Kemiyai taur par acylglycerols fatty acids aur ek alcohol ke esters hain, jo dehydration synthesis se bante hain (acid se OH aur alcohol se H nikalta hai). Sab se zyada paye jane wale acylglycerols triacylglycerols (triglycerides) hain, jinhen neutral lipids bhi kehte hain, jin mein fatty acid ke teen molecules (ek jaise ya mukhtalif) ek glycerol backbone se jure hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke OH alcohol se aur H acid se nikalta hai. Yeh ulta hai. Ester bante waqt acid ke carboxyl (-COOH) group se OH nikalta hai aur alcohol ke -OH group se sirf H nikalta hai; dono mil kar pani (H2O) banate hain. Alcohol ka bacha hua O acid ke C se jur kar ester bond banata hai.

blocks.text_alt: C2H5OH (alcohol) aur HOOCCH3 (acetic acid) mil kar C2H5OCOCH3 (ester) aur H2O (pani) banate hain.

blocks.title: Ester
blocks.text: Ester woh compound hai jo alcohol ke acid se kemiyai reaction se banta hai, jis mein pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai.

items: Glycerol 3-carbon alcohol hai, jis ka har carbon ek hydroxyl group rakhta hai. Is ke teen carbons acylglycerol molecule ka backbone banate hain, jis se teen fatty acids jure hote hain.

Fatty acids acylglycerols ki tamam khususiyat ke zimmedar hain. Yeh lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein hain, jin mein carbon atoms jufti tadaad (even number) mein 4 se 30 tak hain, aur jo carboxyl (-COOH) group par khatam hoti hain. Yeh lambai mein mukhtalif hoti hain aur seedhi zanjeerein (janwaron mein) ya shakhdar ya ring wali (podon mein) ho sakti hain.

blocks.text: Fatty acids do qisam ke hain. Saturated fatty acids ki hydrocarbon zanjeer mein koi double bond nahin hota: tamam andaruni carbon atoms hydrogen side groups rakhte hain, zanjeerein seedhi hoti hain aur melting point ooncha hota hai. Unsaturated fatty acids mein carbon atoms ke ek ya zyada joron ke darmiyan double bonds (zyada se zyada chhe) hote hain; double bonds kuch hydrogen atoms ki jagah le lete hain, is liye unsaturated fatty acids mein hydrogens ki zyada se zyada tadaad se kam hoti hai, yeh muri hui zanjeerein banate hain aur melting point kam hota hai. Fatty acids ka organic solvents mein hal hona aur un ke melting points un ki zanjeeron mein carbon atoms ki tadaad ke saath barhte hain.

blocks.title: Mono- aur poly-unsaturated
blocks.text: Ek double bond wala fatty acid mono-unsaturated hai; ek se zyada double bonds wala poly-unsaturated.

blocks.alt: Ball-and-stick models jin mein har C, H aur O dikhaya gaya. Saturated fatty acid: seedhi zanjeer, har carbon par do H (aakhri par teen), aakhir mein C(=O)OH. Unsaturated fatty acid: C=C double bond (laal) zanjeer ko mor deta hai aur us ke dono carbons par ek ek H hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.32: Fatty acids (kitab ki Figure 4.32 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.32 mein labels ulte chhape hain: seedhi zanjeer jis ke har carbon par poore H hain, us par 'Unsaturated fatty acid' likha hai, aur mudi hui zanjeer par 'Saturated'. Sahih yeh hai: seedhi, poore H wali zanjeer saturated hai; jis zanjeer mein C=C double bond ho, H kam hon aur zanjeer mur jaye, woh unsaturated hai. Hamara khaaka sahih labels dikhata hai.

Acylglycerols apne zyada C-H bonds ki wajah se tawanai (energy) zakheera karne wale moassar molecules hain. Non-polar banawat ki wajah se yeh hal nahin hote, is liye jandar ke andar makhsoos zakheera jagahon par jama kiye ja sakte hain. Janwaron ke fats podon ke oils se zyada tawanai rakhte hain, kyunke un mein saturated fatty acids aur yun zyada C-H bonds hain, jabke podon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids nisbatan kam C-H bonds ke saath hain. Jab jandaron ko glucose lambe arse ke liye zakheera karna ho to woh aam taur par use fats ya oils mein badal dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen fatty acids R-C(=O)-OH (OH roshan) aur glycerol, jis ke teen HO groups ka H roshan hai. Teer, 3H2O nikalte hain, aur triacylglycerol banta hai: har R-C(=O) ek O ke zariye glycerol se jura. Labels: R: Long hydrocarbon chain, 3 Fatty acids, Glycerol, 3H2O, Ester bond, Triacylglycerol.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.33: Triacylglycerol ki dehydration synthesis (kitab ki Figure 4.33 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har fatty acid ka OH aur glycerol ke har OH ka H mil kar pani banate hain; teen fatty acids se teen pani (3H2O) nikalte hain. Bacha hua O fatty acid ke C ko glycerol se jorta hai: yeh ester bond hai. Yaani OH acid (fatty acid) se aur H alcohol (glycerol) se nikalta hai, jaisa khaake mein dikhaya gaya hai.
Waxes

Waxes acylglycerols se nikalte hain. Carbon atoms ki bari tadaad ki wajah se un ke melting points oonche hain, is liye yeh kamre ke darja-hararat par thos hote hain. Kemiyai taur par waxes ki koi wazeh banawat aur tarkeeb nahin: yeh lambi zanjeer wale alkanes (carbon atoms taaq tadaad (odd number) mein, 25 se 35), glycerol ke ilawa alcohols, ketones aur lambi zanjeer wale fatty acids ka mila-jula hain. Waxes kemiyai taur par ghair-faal (inert) hain aur doosre lipids ki tarah sakht hydrophobic, is liye yeh jandaron ke liye hifazati ghilaf aur pani ki rukawat ka kaam karte hain. Yeh phalon aur patton par hifazati tah ke taur par aam hain, aur keere, parinde aur bher jaise kuch janwar apni jild par waxes kharij karte hain.

blocks.title: Waxes ke istemal
blocks.text: Waxes kaghaz aur cards ko waterproof karne, furniture, joote aur gariyon ki wax polish mein, aur mom-battiyan banane mein istemal hote hain; rangdar pigments wale waxes crayons aur rangdar pencils banate hain. Shehad ki makkhiyan wax banati hain aur is se apne chhatton ke chhe-konon wale (hexagonal) khane banati hain jahan shehad zakheera hota hai. Insanon mein wax bahari kaan ki nali ke glands kharij karte hain.
Phospholipids

Phospholipids plasma membranes banane mein aham banawati kirdar ada karte hain. Kemiyai taur par yeh phosphatidic acid se nikalte hain, jo ek glycerol, do fatty acids aur ek phosphoric acid (phosphate) se bana hai. Koi bhi nitrogen wala base, maslan choline, ethanolamine ya serine, us ke phosphoric acid se jur kar phospholipid banata hai; aam misalein phosphatidyl choline (lecithin), phosphatidyl ethanolamine aur phosphatidyl serine hain. Phosphatidyl choline plasma membranes ki lipid bilayer banata hai. Phospholipid ke do hisse hain, sar (head) aur dum (tail): sar polar hai aur nitrogen wala base aur phosphate group rakhta hai, jabke dum non-polar hai aur do fatty acids rakhti hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: chaar ajza formulas ke saath: Glycerol, Fatty acid, Phosphate, Nitrogenous base (Choline). Beech: phospholipid, ek hydrophilic sar (head) aur do hydrophobic dumein (tails). Neeche: poora molecule: choline - phosphate - glycerol, jis par do fatty acids; brackets Phosphatidic acid aur Phosphatidyl choline.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.35: Phosphatidyl choline, ek phospholipid (kitab ki Figure 4.35 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Terpenes

Terpenes lipids ka bohat bara aur mutanawwe group hain. Tamam terpenes isoprene ikaiyon se bane hain; isoprene ikai shakhdar unsaturated hydrocarbon zanjeer hai jis ka formula CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2 hai. Terpenes bohat se hayatiyati (biological) taur par aham pigments banate hain, jaise podon mein chlorophyll aur aankhon mein retinal pigments. Vitamin A aur rubber bhi terpenes hain.

blocks.alt: Baayen: isoprene unit CH2=C(CH3)-CH=CH2. Daayen: isoprene ikaiyon se bani terpene zanjeer, CH2=C(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-OH.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.36: Terpenes ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.36 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Steroids

Steroids woh lipids hain jin ka carbon dhancha mur kar chaar juri hui rings banata hai. Tamam steroids ka ring namoona ek jaisa hai: teen chhe-konon wali rings aur ek paanch-konon wali ring. Cholesterol janwar ke cell membranes mein aam steroid hai, aur janwar ke cells ise doosre steroids, maslan nar aur mada jinsi hormones, banane ke liye bhi istemal karte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar rings jo kinare share kar ke juri hain: teen chhe kone wali aur ek paanch kone wali; pehli ring par HO, doosri ring mein C=C double bond, do ring jorhon par CH3 groups, aur paanch kone wali ring par shaakh-daar hydrocarbon zanjeer CH(CH3)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH3.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.37: Cholesterol: ek steroid (kitab ki Figure 4.37 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaar rings ek doosre se kinare (edge) share kar ke juri hain, kone (corner) se nahin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.37 mein cholesterol ka HO group aur doosri ring ka C=C double bond nahin dikhaye gaye (aur caption mein 'Chdesterol' chhapa hai). Asal cholesterol mein pehli ring par OH group hota hai, isi liye yeh alcohol bhi hai, aur ek double bond hota hai; hamara khaaka yeh dono dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Anabolic steroids
blocks.text: Banaye gaye anabolic steroids nar jinsi hormone testosterone jaise hain aur naron mein baloghat (puberty) ke dauran hone wali muscle aur haddi ke wazan ki aam barhotri paida karte hain. 1950 ki dahai mein kuch dawa sazi companies ne aam anaemia ke ilaj ke liye anabolic steroids banaye, aur kuch athletes ne tezi se muscles banane aur kar-kardagi barhane ke liye inhen istemal karna shuru kiya. Aaj anabolic steroids par pabandi hai: yeh sangeen jismani aur zehni masail, maslan gehri depression aur jigar ko nuqsan, paida kar sakte hain.
Prostaglandins

Prostaglandins lipids ka ek group hain jo badle hue (modified) fatty acids hain, jin ki non-polar dumein paanch-carbon ring se juri hain. Yeh vertebrates ke bohat se tissues mein hote hain, jahan yeh maqami (local) kemiyai paigham-rasan (messengers) ka kaam karte hain. Kuch smooth muscles ko sukarne aur dheela hone par ubharte hain; doosre khoon ki naliyon ka qutr (diameter) tang ya chaura karte hain. Yeh infection ke jawab mein sozish (inflammation) mein bhi shamil hain.

blocks.title: Aspirin
blocks.text: Aspirin prostaglandin ko rokne wali hai, isi liye yeh sozish, dard aur bukhar kam karti hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch carbon ki ring jis par do OH groups hain, aur do zanjeerein: upar CH2 groups ki zanjeer jo C(=O)O- par khatm hoti hai, aur neeche CH=CH-CH(OH)-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.38: Ek prostaglandin (kitab ki Figure 4.38 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Zindagi mein lipids ka kirdar

items: Lipids tawanai (ATP) ke aham zariye hain; dar-asal yeh tamam ghizai ajza mein sab se zyada tawanai wale hain. Ek gram lipid 9.5 kilocalories deta hai, itna hi protein 5.6 kilocalories aur carbohydrate 4.1 kilocalories.
Lipids tamam cellular aur subcellular membranes ke lazmi ajza hain.
Yeh charbi mein hal hone wale vitamins A, D, E aur K ke jazb hone ke liye hayatiyati carriers ka kaam karte hain.
Lipids fatty acids ka zariya hain, jo mukhtalif metabolisms ke liye zaroori hain.
Lipids jism ke aham organs ke liye mechanical cushion aur sahare ka kaam karte hain.
Jild ke neeche ke lipids (fats) jism ko sakht darja-hararat se insulate karte hain.

Steroids bohat se aham hayatiyati kaam karte hain: cholesterol membranes qaim rakhta hai, lipid transport mein madad karta hai, aur vitamin D, bile acids, steroid hormones (androgens, oestrogens), adrenal hormones aur corticosteroids ka precursor hai.

blocks.prompt: Podon ke oils kamre ke darja-hararat par maaye aur janwaron ke fats thos kyun hote hain, aur kaun sa fi gram zyada tawanai zakheera karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Podon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids hain jin ke C=C double bonds zanjeeron ko morte hain, is liye yeh dheela packed hote hain aur kam darja-hararat par pighalte hain. Janwaron ke fats mein saturated fatty acids seedhi zanjeeron ke saath hain jo qareeb packed hote hain aur oonche darja-hararat par pighalte hain. Saturated zanjeeron mein zyada C-H bonds hain, is liye janwaron ke fats zyada tawanai rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Lipids non-polar hain, pani mein hal nahin, organic solvents mein hal: acylglycerols, waxes, phospholipids, terpenes, steroids, prostaglandins.

Acylglycerols glycerol aur fatty acids ke esters hain (triglycerides); saturated fatty acids seedhe aur oonche melting point wale (janwar ke fats), unsaturated mure aur kam melting point wale (poday ke oils); tawanai zakheere ke liye C-H bonds se bharpoor.

Waxes hydrophobic hifazati tah hain; phospholipids (polar sar, do fatty-acid dumein) membranes banate hain; terpenes isoprene polymers hain (chlorophyll, vitamin A, rubber); steroids ki chaar juri rings hain (cholesterol, jinsi hormones); prostaglandins maqami paigham-rasan hain (aspirin inhen rokti hai).
Lipids 9.5 kilocalories fi gram dete hain, membranes banate hain, vitamins A, D, E aur K le jate hain, fatty acids dete hain, organs ko cushion dete hain aur jism ko insulate karte hain.
